blocks.title: Linear search
blocks.text: Linear search checks each item of a list one by one, from the start, until it finds the target or reaches the end.

items: Start at the beginning: look at the first item.
Check each item: compare it with the item you want.
Move to the next if they do not match.
Repeat until you find the item or reach the end.

blocks.text: Searching [Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Faisalabad] for Islamabad: Karachi is not it, Lahore is not it, Islamabad is found at the third check. If Islamabad were not in the list, all the cities would be checked before concluding it is absent. Linear search is O(n).
